confirmation.primary: 100k minus 40k recorded wins against active baseline on matched schedules

limitations: One continued training seed; game-level confidence intervals do not measure training-seed variability.
More games also mean more update rounds and optimizer steps, so this does not isolate sample count from optimization exposure.
Baseline training and confirmation retain the fixed deck/opponent setting.
Head-to-head opponents share schedules but are different comparisons; do not pool them as independent cohorts.
Report all scheduled attempts, draws, cutoffs and errors; unresolved outcomes are unknown rather than invented losses or draws.
Validated fused/cache arithmetic need not produce bitwise-identical future training trajectories.
